text:
Diego: POC alert — MeridianBank seeing repeated 429s during demo import. Demo in 30m, can SE/infra triage?
Rina: On it. Which routes and error text?
Ash: Logs show both /v1/embeddings and /v1/chat/completions returning 429s. Sample: `2024-08-10T14:12:05Z WARN id=xx1 status=429 route=/embeddings reason=per_route_quota_exceeded x-redwood-rate-limit: route=embeddings limit=20rps burst=40`
Ash: They had ~90 concurrent workers, embeddings batch=768.
Rina: That will hit both per-route sustain and token budget if embeddings responses are large. Did presales reserve embeddings?
Diego: Only chat was requested. Customer assumed quota is shared.
Rina: Quick mitigations: ask client to pause import, reduce workers to 10 and batch to 256. I can also apply temporary per-route bump. 
Ash: If you do bump, please use this CLI to mirror what we run: `redwoodctl capacity assign --tenant meridianbank --route embeddings --sustain 80 --burst 160 --until 2024-08-10T20:00:00Z --reason "presales emergency"`
OpsBot: Capacity bump queued by Rina for tenant=meridianbank. Overrides are auditable and billable.
Diego: I've told them to pause for 3 minutes. Apply the bump when ready.
Rina: Applied. Deploy note: capacity bump applied at 2024-08-10T14:13:22Z (embeddings:+60, chat:+40).
Ash: Success rate recovering. 429s dropped within a minute. Recommend leaving override until EOD and update presales intake to include embeddings for ETL demos.
Diego: Agreed. Action items: Rina — update intake form; Ash — attach token-accounting traces to POC ticket; Diego — note billing and confirm demo resumed.
OpsBot: Reminder scheduled to revert override at 2024-08-10T23:58:00Z.
Diego: Demo resumed, customer reports no errors. Closing swarm. :white_check_mark:
